dataset.verticalReference: Unverified; report Z only as LAS Z units.

benchmark.levelsLoaded: All intersecting positive-count EPT nodes, in increasing depth order.
benchmark.pointBudgetDescription: 100k / 500k / 2M are WebGL display budgets only; no EPT source point records are omitted from downloaded/retained LAZ tiles.
benchmark.exactAreaCountDefinition: Decoded source records whose projected X/Y are inside the requested square, counted from actual points.
benchmark.nodePointCountDefinition: All point records in fetched LAZ nodes, including records in intersecting node bounds but outside the exact test square.

areas.attributePreservation: Original compressed LAZ bytes retained for every fetched EPT node; full LAS records are not replaced by the display sample.

retainedDataMemory.note: Measured retained ArrayBuffer/typed-array payload only; excludes JS objects, browser cache, worker WASM heaps, WebGL/GPU buffers and browser overhead.

browserHeap.api: performance.memory (Chromium; does not include all worker/WASM/GPU memory)

responsiveness.note: UI heartbeat ran every 100 ms; a gap of at least 2 seconds is reported as unresponsive. Browser-level OS hangs cannot be inferred from this page.

metadata.requestBounds: Centered square in the selected dataset coordinate system.
metadata.visualDownsampling: WebGL samples only affect displayed buffers; the compressed LAZ payload for every fetched point node is retained separately.

caveats: This is one local browser/device and network run, not a representative sample of ordinary visitors.
Browser heap APIs can omit worker WASM heaps, browser internals and GPU buffers; retained typed-array and compressed byte totals are measured separately.
EPT hierarchy counts identify intersecting nodes; exact in-box counts are computed only after actual LAZ data is fetched and decoded.
Full detail means every positive-count EPT node intersecting the square was downloaded and decoded.
Z units and vertical datum are unverified.
The selected EPT URL and projected coordinates are intentionally omitted from the report.
